hook: A regional football game started in 1896 became a top 10 national showdown.

sections.voiceover: A regional football game started in 1896 became a top 10 national showdown.
In 1896, the University of Utah first played Brigham Young University. The Associated Press later ranked BYU at No. 2 and Utah at No. Where will these 2 rivals meet next?
However, the Holy War doesn't end, as the Big 12 designated 4 protected rivalries.
Now, No. 3 Utah faces No. 7 BYU in Salt Lake City. They battle at Rice-Eccles Stadium on Nov. 7. Kickoff is locked in for 10 a.m. local time.
The Big 12 doesn't stop guaranteeing annual meetings for Utah and BYU.
